command: set -eu; for p in $HOME/.claude/skills/gstack/browse/dist/browse $HOME/scripts/chatgpt_burst_worker_v2.sh $HOME/scripts/chatgpt_burst_state $HOME/.gstack/chromium-profile; do if [ -e "$p" ]; then ls -ld "$p"; else echo MISSING:$p; fi; done; if [ -x /usr/bin/browse ]; then echo SYSTEM_BROWSE_REAL=$(readlink -f /usr/bin/browse); /usr/bin/browse --help 2>&1 | head -5 || true; fi
